outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: (1) fix_leg_proof no longer turns a non-proved fallback into red_refused: the helper's block (could-not-prove included) is held and filed, its basis extended with why the task gate could not stand for the fix leg; red_refused stays only for a helper that gave no block or refused. (2) writer_prove puts no implementationDigest on a fix-by-gate block, and file_writer_return drops one a held by-gate block still carries when it binds; the module docstring's THE INVARIANT and the invariant comment in file_writer_return now exempt the implementation half of a by-gate proof. (3) gate_binding(ctx, state, manifest, phase, task, proof) binds only when the gated run holds a step of the proof's own command (writer_test_text, new: the unsplit red_command; matched verbatim or by commandSha256 in proof_steps), and step_standing finds that step not repeated, exit 0 with no outcome, unmuted, with a ran count >= the task leg's collected count (fixLegOwes, held beside the proof), and no multi-file sweep red files whose per-file count no row keeps; the coverage check is kept. A bound block's basis gains a clause naming the run, the command, the step's count against the task leg's and the files named. stamp-verification.py: fix_leg_owes + FIX_LEG_OWES ('fixLegOwes') payload key, written only beside a fixLeg block: {collected, redFiles (sweep_red_counts), files}. Tests: test_drive_phase fbg3 rewritten (step + basis + no impl digest), fbg10-fbg16 added, fbg4-fbg6 rows carry the proof's step; wi7 end-to-end bound path over a new pytest-shaped fixture suite (_wf_pytest_suite, _tdd_writer_repo head_test=); test_stamp_verification fg9/fg10. Red before fix: ux-block 151/156 with fbg3, fbg10, fbg11, fbg12, fbg13 FAIL; helper stage raised AttributeError FIX_LEG_OWES. Mutation probe in a scratch worktree (removed): each of 9 mutations killed its case (fbg12, fbg11, fbg13, fbg10, fbg14, fbg3, fbg15, fg9+fg10, wi7), restored stages 158/158 and 10/10. Gate: first full run exit 1 on cl5 (SIGTERM process-group timing case in sr-concurrent-legs, code this task did not touch); that stage passed alone twice and the helper suite whole via the sweep (402 cases, exit 0); second full gate run exit 0, '2/2 files ok'. Pre-gate exit 0; ruff, vermin, house_style_violations, prose_number_claims, doc_prose_numbers clean on touched files; tests/test__filed_returns.py 120/120. Dependants: settle_aside unchanged and still correct (re-gates, then prove_and_hold); tree_since_proof unchanged and correct (by-gate ignores implementation; its docstring names gate_binding, still true); _filed_returns.fix_leg_problem/mechanical_answers still correct (bound block keeps fixLegRunId; extended basis still opens with the helper prefix _HELPER_BASIS matches); execute-task.md (not in this task's files, not edited) stays true but incomplete: its 'only when that run ... named each test file' is still a necessary condition, and 'that proof is held and filed' is now true for a non-proved fallback too, but it does not name the step-of-the-proof's-command and count conditions - a follow-up should add them. Other importers of drive-phase.py call none of the changed functions (git grep: only execute-task.md names gate_binding/fix_leg_proof). Consequence to note: a step whose runner prints no count the gate reads (house suites, the sweep - summary_count is None for both, and a recorded sweep row shows ran: null) never binds, so this repo's own writer proofs take the fix leg as before; binding them needs run-test-gate/_evidence_io to record a count (and per-file counts for a sweep), outside this task's files. FIX_LEG_OWES is spelled in both entry points, held equal by fbg16; _filed_returns (beside FIX_LEG_FIELD) is the better single home, outside this task's files.
outcome.descriptive: A writer's fix-by-gate proof binds only to a green run whose own step of the proof's command passed over at least the task leg's count, says what that run showed, carries no stale implementation digest, and a fallback that cannot prove is filed as could-not-prove instead of stranding the return.
